snippet.title: Dithered Official Announcement Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The pavement ends in a void. The sky is bleeding pixels. Welcome to the nightmare.

DĪȾĦɆꞦɆĐ is coming. Wishlist now on Steam: 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4234320/Dithered/

Something is wrong with the morning. In this surreal action-platformer, you must guide a young girl through a "3D diorama" of trauma and memory. Guided by two bickering parrots and hunted by the terrifying Clock-Head Boy, you must fight through the static to reach the classroom.

The world has glitched. Can you survive the decay?
